title: Elon Musk says he's had AI 'psychosis' half a dozen times in the last year
key_facts: Elon Musk, Tesla chief executive, spoke at the X Takeover event on a Saturday.
He said 'I've got a little bit of cyber psychosis. Maybe a lot actually.'
He said he had 'AI or SI psychosis' probably half a dozen times in the past year.
'SI' refers to President Trump's renaming of AI to super intelligence.
AI psychosis is not a clinical term; it is often used for AI use deepening a user's delusions.
Marc Andreessen and Garry Tan have joked about the term; Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar called Silicon Valley's mindset 'mass psychosis'.
quote_evidence: "I've got a little bit of cyber psychosis," Musk said. "Maybe a lot actually."
AI psychosis, which is not a clinical term, doesn't have a set definition, but it's often referred to as when repeated AI use deepens a user's delusions.
why_it_matters_hint: A light remark about AI intensity from Musk, picking up a joke already common among tech leaders.
notes: Event date inferred: 'Saturday' before a Wednesday 14 Oct report is 10 Oct 2026; the article does not print the date.
